items.title: Canaan may sell more bitcoin for stock buybacks as mining-rig revenue falls 96%
items.summary: The Avalon maker has launched a $20 million repurchase program, while most of its bitcoin holdings were pledged or placed in a fixed-term product at September’s end.

items.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
items.summary: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indices could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

items.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
items.summary: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

items.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
items.summary: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

items.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
items.summary: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

items.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
items.summary: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

items.title: Crypto Long &amp; Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending

items.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
items.summary: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

items.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
items.summary: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin remains under pressure as CoreWeave, Nvidia lead AI rebound
items.summary: The DRAM ETF jumps 8% and semiconductor stocks gain more than 4%, while bitcoin continues to test its 200-day moving average.

items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
items.summary: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.

items.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
items.summary: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

items.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
items.summary: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

items.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
items.summary: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

items.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
items.summary: The report about Huang’s possible departure came after the New York Times reported that he had a second extramarital affair.

items.title: Uncalled US House races could send more crypto allies to Congress
items.summary: The remaining races feature pro-crypto candidates and others without a stated position, giving advocacy groups what they see as “an opportunity” for outreach.

items.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
items.summary: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

items.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
items.summary: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.

items.title: Pressure Mounts on Nvidia's Jensen Huang Amid Reports of Second Affair
items.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to oust its CEO, sending the chipmaker's shares down more than 5% in premarket trading.

items.title: Nvidia-Backed CoreWeave Is Surging: Here’s What It Means for the AI Boom
items.summary: CoreWeave's 168% revenue jump sent its shares soaring and lifted Nvidia and other AI stocks. Strong demand is reassuring investors, but the cost of building it remains enormous.

items.title: Stablecoin Drain, ETF Outflows Leave Bitcoin 'Running on Empty'
items.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in 30 days, the fastest contraction since June 2022, amid weak ETF demand.

items.title: Bitcoin Short-Term Holders Send $3.6 Billion in BTC to Exchanges at a Loss
items.summary: Recent buyers are moving billions in Bitcoin to exchanges below their purchase prices, while Binance sees sharp inflows from recently moved coins.

items.title: This New AI Music Model Is Already Better Than Suno—We Put ACE to the Test
items.summary: ACE Music v1 tops the AI music rankings with more natural vocals and stronger song structure. Our tests found impressive results, though niche genres remain a challenge.

items.title: Tether's Tiny AI Agent Beats Models 2.5 Times Its Size at Controlling Your Phone
items.summary: BotPsy packs 800 million parameters into an AI assistant designed to manage everyday tasks locally, outperforming larger rivals as Tether expands its push into decentralized artificial intelligence.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Goes Live With Crypto Custody After a Five-Year Buildup
items.summary: Deutsche Bank’s custody service now holds Bitcoin, Ethereum and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe.

items.title: Bitcoin Faces First Back-to-Back Annual Losses in History, But There's a Catch
items.summary: Bitcoin is heading toward its first consecutive losing years, breaking an 18-year pattern. But there's some nuance in the data.

items.title: What Are Solana Privacy Rings? Inside Helius’ Privacy Protocol for Solana
items.summary: Solana Privacy Rings encrypt balances and transfer amounts without leaving Solana. Here's how they work, and how they compare.

items.title: A High-Severity Bug Could Have Stalled Bitcoin Mining—Bitcoin Core Has a Fix
items.summary: Three bugs—spanning denial-of-service and privacy issues rather than coin theft—have all been patched, with the most serious capable of halting a miner’s ability to build new blocks.
